summary: Independent verifier inspected layered verification schemas, implementation, tests, evidence manifests, and reran validation. The review requests changes because selection reuses current passed Evidence without a stored fingerprint, so criterion 3 is not satisfied.

criteria.criterion: Selection is deterministic for the same graph, changes and policy.
criteria.notes: Selection output is sorted and deterministic for the same graph, trigger, and policy; targeted test coverage passed.

criteria.criterion: Failed Gates, affected Claims, downstream integration boundaries, and mandatory safety Gates are selected.
criteria.notes: Failed gates, affected claims, integration-boundary gates, and mandatory safety claim gates are selected by the implementation and covered by tests.

criteria.criterion: Unchanged current Evidence is reused only when fingerprints match.
criteria.notes: The implementation reuses current passed Evidence when stored_fingerprint is absent. Independent probe observed EVD-no-stored-fingerprint in reusedEvidenceRefs, so reuse is not limited to evidence whose fingerprints match.

criteria.criterion: Completion fails for missing, stale, expired, revoked or contradicted Evidence.
criteria.notes: Completion fails closed for missing, stale, expired, revoked, contradicted evidence and unresolved defects.

criteria.criterion: A failed Gate creates a structured Defect with exact Claim, Gate, expected/actual, refs and repair boundary.
criteria.notes: Failed or blocked VerificationResult creates a DefectRecord carrying claim, gate, expected, actual, refs, repair boundary, and open status.

criteria.criterion: The selective fixture executes fewer Gates than the declared full set and records the rationale.
criteria.notes: The fixture selects fewer gates than the full declared set and records deterministic rationale while final logical coverage remains complete.

criteria.criterion: The existing Task completion path remains fail-closed during migration.
criteria.notes: The existing task EvidenceGate path is preserved and still rejects approval reports without evidence_refs.

commands.command: uv run python -B -m unittest tests.test_verification tests.test_schemas -v

commands.notes: AHRA lint 0 failures; verification and defect examples validated.
All artifact-manifest and evidence-manifest local hashes matched.
Probe completed and observed EVD-no-stored-fingerprint in reusedEvidenceRefs when stored_fingerprint was absent.
